title: Fix Background Click Recompute Flash
description: Clicking flow canvas background triggers computing animation on all nodes. Gate evaluate/persist on pointer up to tree changes only; fix fixtureJson prop effect resetting lastEvalFixtureRef on presentational-only updates.
summary: Background clicks no longer trigger full-graph computing chrome. Pointer-up now snapshots the fixture on pointer-down and only calls evaluate()/persistFixture() when flowTreeDirtyNeuronIds detects a compute-tree change (slider/edge/param), not selection-only or layout/camera updates. The fixtureJson prop effect also skips resetting lastEvalFixtureRef and re-evaluating when the external fixture differs only presentationally.
